import httpx
from google import genai
from google.genai import types
from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
from orchestration.beta_vertex_research import BetaVertexResearchRuntime
requests=[]
def respond(request):
 requests.append(request)
 return httpx.Response(200,json={'candidates':[{'content':{'role':'model','parts':[{'text':'{"synthetic":true}'}]},'finishReason':'STOP'}]})
with genai.Client(vertexai=True,project='ocean-v1-beta-20261101',location='global',credentials=Credentials(token='synthetic-test-only'),http_options=types.HttpOptions(api_version='v1',retry_options=types.HttpRetryOptions(attempts=1),client_args={'transport':httpx.MockTransport(respond)})) as client:
 runtime=BetaVertexResearchRuntime(project='ocean-v1-beta-20261101',location='global',embedding_dim=768,max_attempts=1,client=client)
 result=runtime.structured_chat_result(model='gemini-3.8-flash',prompt='Synthetic test only',schema={'type':'object'},max_output_tokens=4096,timeout=10)
assert result.status=='completed' and len(requests)==1
assert requests[0].url.host=='aiplatform.googleapis.com'
body=json.loads(requests[0].content)
assert set(body['generationConfig'])=={'responseMimeType','responseJsonSchema','maxOutputTokens','thinkingConfig'}
assert body['generationConfig']['thinkingConfig']=={'thinking_level':'LOW','include_thoughts':False}
assert body['generationConfig']['maxOutputTokens']==4096
print('Corrected Gemini SDK request serialization verified with synthetic credentials and mock HTTP, network disabled')
